rows.label: Host security
rows.behavior: Reserved on HTTP and HTTPS; host emits fixed policy (HSTS on HTTPS only). Guest conflict returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Host transport/framing
rows.behavior: Guest fields forbidden. Use typed media-type/representation-length/body; transport owns framing. Invalid output returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Hop-by-hop
rows.behavior: Forbidden in the buffered profile; no chunking, trailers, upgrades or guest connection control. Invalid output returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Identity/credential forwarding
rows.behavior: Forbidden guest output; request identity fields are stripped by host mapping. Never an application principal channel; conflict returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Platform namespace
rows.behavior: Reserved platform namespace. Guest output returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Unsupported browser policy
rows.behavior: Forbidden; guests cannot add CORS, alternate navigation, reporting or embedding policy. Conflict returns fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Conditional application fields
rows.behavior: Location: singleton canonical root-relative redirect (or 201). Encoding: singleton identity. Set-Cookie: bounded unique HTTPS __Host- cookies with exact attributes. Vary: application field; private host caching needs approved dimensions. Failed value rules return fixed no-store 502.

rows.label: Application cache input
rows.behavior: Accepted bounded input. Host strips supplied Cache-Control/Age from dynamic wire output and emits no-store plus its own local-hit Age. Duplicate/unsafe cache directives bypass host caching; they do not authorize shared browser/proxy caching.

rows.label: Credential-sensitive application data
rows.behavior: Accepted as bounded application response fields; never platform authentication. Authors must classify their data and avoid disclosing credentials. Set-Cookie uses the separate strict conditional profile.

rows.label: Other application fields
rows.behavior: Other canonical lowercase HTTP-token names are accepted (for example etag, last-modified, expires, content-language and x-app-*). Ordinary duplicate fields are retained; applications define their semantics. All fields obey the shared grammar and finite budgets.

wireRules.case: Classify collisions case-insensitively; actual guest wire names must already be lowercase.
wireRules.values: No controls including CR/LF/HTAB/DEL, and no leading/trailing space; bounded opaque non-control bytes otherwise.
wireRules.duplicates: No general deduplication or precedence. Location and content-encoding are singleton; Set-Cookie names are unique and attributes cannot repeat. Duplicate Cache-Control/unsafe Vary disable host cache eligibility.
wireRules.cookies: HTTPS only; __Host- name with nonempty suffix, exact Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict/Path=/ attributes in any order; only optional Max-Age=0 deletion, no Domain/Expires/other lifetime or SameSite mode.
wireRules.typedFields: Status 200..599. Body empty for HEAD/204/205/304. representation-length only on HEAD or 304, never 204/205. Dynamic HTML exactly text/html; charset=utf-8 with valid UTF-8. Missing media becomes application/octet-stream.
wireRules.rejection: Reject invalid guest output before writing bytes or publishing pending cache fills, retain delivery ownership for cleanup, return fixed no-store 502 with the 12-byte ASCII body Bad gateway followed by LF (empty for HEAD) while writable, allow successful later requests. Expired/disconnected transports may close without output.
wireRules.disclosure: Developer helpers expose fixed local reason codes only. Runtime operator diagnostics use typed OutputValidation/HttpResponseRejected under current scope authorization; public HTTP receives no raw diagnostic, header value, token or payload.
